name: wptaskify Search Signal for MCP
author: saurabhbhayana

sections.description:
Search is changing. AI answer engines – ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, Claude – now answer questions directly and cite sources, and AI bots crawl your content constantly. Search Signal is a free plugin built for this new reality, alongside all the classic SEO essentials.

See and control AI crawlers

  • AI crawler log – which AI bots visited (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended, CCBot, Bytespider and more), when, and on which pages. Runs entirely on your site.
  • Bot classification – every bot is sorted into Training (takes content to train models), AI-Search (can cite you and send traffic) and Agent (a real person’s AI visiting now), so you know who to allow or block.
  • AI Access Control – one click writes the right robots.txt rules to allow or block any AI bot, by type.
  • AI referral traffic – see visitors who arrived from an AI answer (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Copilot).
  • Dead-link finder for AI – spot the 404s AI bots hit so you can fix them.

Score your content for AI answer engines (AEO / GEO)

  • AI SEO Score – a site-wide scorecard across On-Page, Technical, AEO (answer-engine) and GEO (AI-citation), measured from your own published content.
  • Per-post AEO Analyzer – checks each post for a direct answer, FAQ block, citation-readiness, a clear entity definition and freshness.
  • Brand Visibility – see how an AI assistant describes your brand and what to improve (optional, uses the wptaskify service – see External services).

Classic SEO, done right

  • SEO title & meta description with a live Google-style snippet preview
  • Focus keyword with a real-time SEO score
  • Open Graph (Facebook) and Twitter Card tags
  • Canonical URLs and noindex control
  • JSON-LD structured data: Organization, WebSite, Breadcrumb, Article, Product, FAQPage, HowTo
  • Automatic XML sitemap and llms.txt
  • On-the-fly image WebP for faster pages (originals kept – SEO-safe)
  • robots.txt editor

Optional: connect to AI (Claude & ChatGPT)

You can optionally connect your site to wptaskify so an AI assistant (Claude or ChatGPT) can read and update your SEO for you through a secure connector. This is entirely optional – every feature above works on its own without connecting.

External services

This plugin can OPTIONALLY connect to the third-party service wptaskify (https://wptaskify.com). It contacts wptaskify only when YOU take an action – never automatically in the background. If you never click Connect or run a Brand check, this plugin makes no external requests.

  • Connect to AI: When you click “Connect to AI”, the plugin creates a WordPress Application Password and sends your site URL, WordPress username, account email, and that Application Password to wptaskify so an AI assistant you authorize can manage your SEO. Clicking “Disconnect” sends your site URL to wptaskify to remove the connection. While connected, the plugin checks your connection/plan status by sending your site URL to wptaskify.
  • Brand Visibility: When you click “Check what AI says about my brand”, the plugin sends your site URL and brand/site name to wptaskify, which asks an AI model and returns the answer. Requires an active connection.
  • Why: So an AI assistant you authorize can read and write your SEO on your instruction, and so we can show how AI describes your brand.
  • Service provider: wptaskify – Terms of Use: https://wptaskify.com/terms – Privacy Policy: https://wptaskify.com/privacy

Google Analytics (only if YOU enable it): If you enter a Google Analytics 4 Measurement ID in the plugin’s settings, the plugin loads Google’s analytics script (https://www.googletagmanager.com/gtag/js) on your public pages so Google can measure your traffic. This happens only when you have set a GA4 ID; leave it blank and no Google script is loaded. Data (page views and visitor information) is sent to Google under your own Analytics account.

  • Service provider: Google – Terms of Service: https://policies.google.com/terms – Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/, or install it from Plugins > Add New.
  2. Activate it.
  3. Edit any post or page – the SEO box appears below the editor with a live snippet preview and score.
  4. Open wptaskify > AI Traffic to see which AI bots crawl your site and control their access.
  5. (Optional) Open wptaskify > Dashboard > Connect to AI to let Claude or ChatGPT manage your SEO.
sections.faq:
Is this plugin free?

Yes. The AI crawler log, bot control, AEO score, schema, sitemap, meta, WebP and robots.txt tools are all free and work without any account.

Do I have to connect to wptaskify?

No. Connecting is optional. Everything except Brand Visibility works with no account and no external requests. Connect only if you want an AI assistant to manage your SEO.

Can this plugin really block AI bots?

It writes the correct robots.txt rules for you. Reputable bots (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Perplexity) obey robots.txt; some ignore it. For hard blocking, use a firewall or CDN. The plugin makes this honest and clear in the UI.

Does the crawler log catch every AI bot?

It logs bots that identify themselves in their user-agent. Some AI agents browse anonymously and cannot be detected from server logs – the plugin says so and never claims otherwise.

Does it work with the block editor and classic editor?

Yes, both.

Will it conflict with another SEO plugin?

Run one SEO plugin at a time to avoid duplicate meta tags.

What data leaves my site?

Nothing, unless you click Connect or run a Brand check. See “External services” above for exactly what is sent and when.
sections.changelog:
1.0.0

  • Initial release: AI crawler log with Training/AI-Search/Agent classification, one-click AI Access Control (robots.txt), AI referral tracking, dead-link finder, AI SEO Score, per-post AEO Analyzer, Brand Visibility, SEO meta + focus keyword + score, schema (Article, FAQ, HowTo, Product, Organization, WebSite, Breadcrumb), Open Graph, Twitter Cards, canonical, noindex, XML sitemap, llms.txt, image WebP, robots.txt editor, and an optional AI connector.
